flatten_message_history: flatten a list of phase messages into a formatted string with sender recipient and message content
unflatten_model_output_messages: unflatten a model output string back into a list of outbound message dictionaries with sender and recipient
extract_message_history_from_game_json: extract all messages visible to a given speaker from a game JSON up to the current phase
build_all_possible_message_histories: build all possible message history tuples through time for a given speaker and phase in a game
add_message_to_game_copy: insert a new message into a specified phase of a pydipcc game and return a new game object
